build_MaskedAutoencoderViT: build a MaskedAutoencoderViT model with custom encoder and decoder dimensions for masked image modeling
create_mae_vit_base: create a MAE ViT base model with patch size 16 and 384-dim decoder using mae_vit_base_patch16_dec384d12h8b
create_mae_vit_large: create a MAE ViT large model with patch size 16 and 512-dim decoder using mae_vit_large_patch16_dec512d16h8b
run_forward_encoder: run the forward encoder on image patches with random masking using ids_keep and ids_restore indices
run_forward_decoder: run the forward decoder to reconstruct masked image patches from encoded latent representations
